verdict.rationale: Ledgy is an equity-management SaaS. Such a platform could plausibly embed an AI assistant that consumes external tools, so the MCP-client axis applies. However, nothing in the pack mentions MCP, an embedded agent, or any way to plug in external tool servers. The evidence covers only its OAuth service-account API (auth, companyCaptable, companyTransactions) and HRIS and paying-agent integrations, and the llms.txt and OpenAPI probes returned 404.
